content_data.meeting_title: Strategic Alignment Workshop: Healthcare Efficiency Initiative Phase 1 Review
agenda_items: Open forum for challenges and opportunities in scaling solutions
Presentation of preliminary recommendations for process optimization
Review of Phase 1 KPIs and performance metrics for pilot sites
Discussion on observed operational bottlenecks and root causes
Analysis of stakeholder feedback from clinical and administrative staff
key_decisions: Schedule follow-up workshops with individual site leadership to tailor recommendations.
Approve the development of a cost-benefit analysis for proposed technology integration solutions.
Prioritize implementation of a standardized patient intake protocol across all pilot sites by next month.
action_items: Client Leadership: Designate task force members for EHR interoperability initiative. (Due: +5 days)
Consultant Team: Prepare initial draft of cost-benefit analysis for technology solutions. (Due: +14 days)
Consultant Team: Document and distribute meeting minutes and decisions to all attendees. (Due: +1 day)
Consultant Team: Develop detailed implementation plan for standardized patient intake protocol. (Due: +7 days)
